disambiguation: Not a standard calendar; it visualizes dates found in Markdown notes.
extras: Read the Google data privacy policy before connecting your account.
problem: Users lack a visual, calendar-based interface to track and quickly access notes containing specific dates within their Markdown vault.

relations.evidence: optional Google Calendar sync uses desktop loopback OAuth with PKCE.

summary: Manta Calendar finds dates within Markdown notes and displays them in a calendar view, allowing users to open the source note and optionally sync events with Google Calendar.
